rationale.automation-bias: Experienced developers report secure-coding proficiency declining when using generative AI.
rationale.quality-debt: Respondents report harder code comprehension and heightened documentation and maintainability concerns.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Developers report using SonarQube, scanning, and testing on generated code.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Developers practice manual review before integration and caution before production deployment.
